To address this, we introduce PacifAIst, a benchmark of 700 scenarios testing self-preservation, resource acquisition, and deception. We evaluated eight state-of-the-art large language models, revealing a significant performance hierarchy. Google’s Gemini 2.5 Flash demonstrated the strongest human-centric alignment (90.31%), while the highly anticipated GPT-5 scored lowest (79.49%), indicating potential risks.
